title: Jacky Chou on SEO: rank and rent, blogs, and daily YouTube as a funnel
summary: Jacky Chou talks through his current business mix (local SEO software, display ads, agency, private community) and what is working in SEO now. He covers rank and rent via verified Google locations, careful blogging after Google's crackdown, and daily YouTube content as a trust engine that feeds a paid community.

principles.text: SEO shifts fast and penalties are near-permanent, so pivot quickly rather than clinging to one play.
principles.quote: That's why I think in the SEO space you gota you got to pivot so fast.

principles.text: Daily YouTube builds trust, and a large share of viewers convert into a paid private community.
principles.quote: it kind of proved out doing daily YouTube videos is worth it despite my low numbers cuz like a huge percentage of those people will convert to um a private community member cuz they feel so close to you and they trust you.

principles.text: For local rank and rent, getting a Google location verified is the step that unlocks inbound calls.
principles.quote: What you typically need to do in rank and rents is get a Google location verified. If people want to get into it, just get it get it verified.

principles.text: Local SEO is far easier to rank outside the US, in markets like Australia, Canada, the UK and Germany.
principles.quote: you go to out go outside of the US like Australia, uh, Canada, UK, so easy.

principles.text: Blogs still work, but publish a couple of optimized posts a day, not hundreds, or your domain gets burned.
principles.quote: Try to do maybe one, two posts a day. That's it. Don't do the hundreds of posts a day you see on X.

principles.text: When starting content, post daily and double down on whatever format performs; opportunity inflow alone can justify it.
principles.quote: just create content every day, cuz then it's it's so easy right now to just pop off cuz if you're not dumb and you see like, oh, this video is doing well, this video flopped, just do more of the ones that are doing well
